style: A single fortress drawn as a map symbol for a hand-drawn fantasy map in the style of the map's mountains: grey-black ink and pencil line work with soft grey wash shading on nothing, slightly elevated three-quarter view, crisp contour lines and hatching, no colour except ink greys, no paper texture, no ground plane beyond a small rocky base, isolated on a fully transparent background, centred with generous empty margin. An original drawing. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, frame or border. Subject:

items.minas-tirith: a great white city of seven tiered concentric walls built against the side of a mountain, a tall slender citadel tower at the top and a jutting rock prow dividing the tiers.
items.minas-morgul: a sinister pale fortress city in a dark narrow valley, a tall thin tower whose top slowly turns, jagged walls and a bridge over a pale river in front of the gate.
items.helms-deep: a mountain-gorge fortress: a stout keep on a rock spur, a long thick defensive wall closing the mouth of a narrow ravine between steep cliffs, a culvert under the wall.
items.barad-dur: the colossal dark tower of the Dark Lord: a gigantic black fortress tower rising from jagged foundations on a rocky ridge, with huge buttresses, battlements and a crown of sharp iron pinnacles at its summit.
items.dol-amroth: a proud seaside castle on a rocky headland above the sea, tall pale towers and strong walls, small waves breaking on the rocks below and a little harbour with a sailing ship.
items.dol-guldur: a grim dark fortress on a bare hill rising out of a dense tangled forest, broken black towers and walls, dead twisted trees around it.
items.erebor: a lone tall mountain with a great dwarven gate carved into its side between two massive square stone pillars, a stone stair before it and a stream flowing out from under the gate.
items.grey-havens: an elven harbour town at the head of a long gulf: slender white towers, curving stone quays and two graceful elven ships with tall swan-like prows at anchor.
items.lorien: an elven city among giant smooth-barked mallorn trees: slender wooden platforms high in the branches, stairs winding up the great trunks and a low earthen wall around their feet.
items.morannon: the Black Gate: a massive iron double gate in a huge wall closing a pass between two steep mountain ridges, with a tall grim watch tower on each side.
items.moria: the West-gate of an ancient dwarven city under a mountain: a tall arched stone doorway with two carved pillars at the foot of a sheer cliff, a still dark pool before it and two holly trees beside it, no runes or inscriptions.
items.mount-gundabad: a jagged mountain peak riddled with orc fortifications: crude stone walls, rough watchtowers and dark cave mouths cut into its cliffs.
items.orthanc: a single tall black tower made of four sharp-edged piers of stone rising from a great ring of stone walls on a wide circular plain, its summit split into four horn-like spikes.
items.rivendell: a hidden elven refuge in a deep wooded valley: a graceful house with slender towers, terraces and arched bridges beside a waterfall falling into a river.
items.umbar: a corsair haven: a walled coastal fortress on a rocky shore with a harbour behind a stone mole, where galleys with oars and dark sails lie at anchor.
items.woodland-realm: an elven king's halls delved into a forested hill: a great carved stone gate at the end of a bridge over a forest river, surrounded by tall dense trees.
